facts.value: Every invocation increments yoyoCurrentFrame and runs ftNs_AttackHi4_YoyoThink_IsRemove. Further processing is skipped only when that controller returns true, which occurs after scheduled yo-yo creation fails. Ordinary timed despawn returns false. On the false path, cmd_vars[0] == 0 permits a positive rehit timer to decrement; expiration invokes lbColl_80008440 followed by lbColl_80008434 on x914. Exhausted animation frames then invoke ft_8008A2BC.

facts.value: Runs ft_80084104 on Ness's fighter GObj, then tests the resulting airborne state and stored yo-yo pointer. With an airborne fighter and non-null article it calls it_802BE958. That item removal path can call ftNs_AttackHi4_YoyoItemSetFlag on the owner, restoring post-hitlag flags and clearing the fighter association before deleting linked objects. The collision callback reloads Fighter, calls it_802BE5B8 only if yoyo_gobj remains non-null, and finally clears yoyo_gobj. The secondary call restores item flags; it is not a second item deletion.
